items.title: Langtang Valley trek reopens
items.summary: Rasuwa, October 29 The Langtang Valley trekking route has reopened following the construction of alternative trails. Although the Bhotekoshi flood damaged the Pasang Lhamu Highway and infrastructure in the Syabrubesi area, new trekking routes have been opened to ensure the safety of trekkers. items.title: Insurers have paid just 4 percent of Bhotekoshi flood claims
items.summary: Payouts total Rs821.39 million against Rs20.9 billion in claims nearly two months after the disaster, with the final bill expected to rise.
